transmission_metadata.motor_coordinate_equation: s=[2*yaw,2*hip,2*knee]; normalized actuator directions require commissioning
transmission_metadata.provenance: Design assumptions pending packaging and loaded reversal/deflection/efficiency measurement; motor travel is usable span around calibrated neutral, not absolute zero.

limitations: Bearing races stay with their declared envelope group.
Internal rotors keep their assembled phase relative to their housing; no gear or belt mates.
Rigid groups do not model print compliance, backlash, cable flex or structural strength.
